performance.verdict: Leads arriving but zero signed cases; GHL intake and SOW gaps are the real risk.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (all due Jul 31–Aug 1): pre-launch stack test, LSA verification, site/landing pages, Ads launch, Meta retargeting — none show a completed event.
CPL dropped to $158.95 on 18 Meta leads (28d), but Google Ads shows 7 conversions against $2,120.45 spend — $302.92 per Google conversion, with no signed-case data to validate either number.
GHL shows 74 opportunities created from 206 contacts with 0 won and 0 appointments — leads are entering the pipeline but not converting to consults; intake leak, not an ads problem.
3-day lead signal (Sep 11–13: 3+2+1=6 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10: 2+1+4=7) — momentum is flattening after the surge; spend averaged $170/day over the same window.
GBP actions fell 58% week-over-week to near-zero (0 actions on Sep 12–13), while paid spend continued — organic local intent is dropping against paid activity.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA verification blocking ~$5,000/mo Google budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due Jul 31–Aug 1 have no completed event as of Sep 14: pre-launch stack test, LSA verification, site/landing pages, Ads launch, and Meta retargeting. LSA verification alone gates the full ~$5,000/mo Google spend intended in the SOW. Nacer to confirm status of each item and provide a revised completion date by Sep 17. Success check: all five milestones marked complete or have a committed date by Sep 21.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 74 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — add booking step or speed-to-lead audit within pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 74 opportunities created from 206 contacts over 28 days, yet 0 appointments and 0 won cases are recorded — this is an intake process failure, not an ads volume problem. The SOW requires first contact under 5 minutes and 24/7 AI chat intake, neither of which can be confirmed from current data. Nacer to audit the pipeline stage-by-stage drop-off and confirm whether booking/calendar automation is live. Success check: at least 1 appointment logged in GHL within 7 days of fix going live, re-check Sep 21.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead momentum through Sep 17; 3-day signal flattened at 6 leads vs prior 7 — hold budget at current ~$50/day.
suggestions.monday_update: The 366.67% week-over-week lead surge has flattened in the 3-day window (Sep 11–13: 6 leads vs Sep 8–10: 7 leads) with spend holding around $170/day. No scale action is warranted until intake (S2) is confirmed working, so that new leads have a functional path to consult. Re-check Sep 17: if 3-day leads hold at 6+ and at least 1 appointment is booked, a +15% Meta budget increase is defensible.
